column1: # Builds the tree INTENDS to fail. One row per (package, feature), tab-separated:
#   package <TAB> feature <TAB> expires <TAB> obligation <TAB> guard file <TAB> guard literal
# The guard literal is a substring of the `compile_error!` message. `scripts/check_build_expected_failures.py`
# validates each row against the tree: the package and feature exist, the literal is present and
# under the feature's cfg, the entry has not expired, every cfg-gated compile_error! in the
# workspace is listed, and (unless --source-only) the configuration still fails with that literal.
# A configuration that starts compiling is STALE and fails the check. The instruments derive their
# feature set from cargo metadata minus these pairs; they never hand-type a feature list.
